title: FuZhouPlan
description: This mod adds some creature-related content to MC
body:
# Introduction
In this mod, you will gain the power to control the movement of creatures (but is that really true?).

You need to craft syringes and collect green berries to make anesthetic so that you can immobilize creatures.

# Precautions
Never use it on creatures that are too strong, otherwise it won't work because the creature's health exceeds 20 points, and then you might be killed by that hostile creature...

# What will be done in the future?
In future plans, the author has the following considerations:
1. Add more technology-related content (such as creature catchers, creature storage devices)

2. Add more items (like blue berries? ~~Although the author doesn’t know what blue berries can be used for~~)

If you have better ideas, you can always tell the author!
